summary: STORE-012A GENERATE CONCEPT BOARD backend verified end-to-end (10/10 pytest passing). POST /api/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions/generate appends new Direction Sets without overwriting prior ones (next set_index = max(prior)+1, fresh set_id, label 'Direction Set NN'), letters scheme matches set_index (A/B/C for set 1, A2/B2/C2 for set 2, A3/B3/C3 for set 3+), each direction returns moodboard_id + direction_name + 5-color palette + 3-entry style_dna_snapshot + counts{materials,products,images} + needs_flags[]. GET /api/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions returns sets grouped + sorted by set_index with full direction payload (title/status/updated_at/counts/needs_flags). Tenant has 0 products → all 3 generated boards on every set flag NEEDS_PRODUCT_SELECTION (not blocked, still created). Direction name rotation across sets confirmed via two successive POSTs. STORE-011 regression endpoints (/discover/catalog, /discover-brief, /discover-brief/intelligence) still healthy. Frontend partial: dbe-* test IDs render correctly on wizard steps (dbe-close, dbe-progress, dbe-rail-snapshot..notes, dbe-step-snapshot, dbe-prev/next, dbe-blueprint-panel) but the Summary view containing dbe-generate-concepts / dbe-generate-more / dbe-set-N / dbe-concept-* / dbe-open-* did NOT render on first load of /studio/journey/:jid/discover even though completion=100% — wizard opens on step 1 by default. Likely needs user to navigate through all 7 steps to reach the Summary state, or main agent should route directly to Summary when discovery_status==completed.

critical_code_review_comments: concept_directions.py ~590 LOC — within target. Clear separation: palette library, direction name registry, asset pools, element seeding, core board creation, endpoints. Zero new tables — concept_seed lives inside moodboards.ai_metadata as documented.

Every generated moodboard has journey_id set + ai_metadata.concept_seed populated with set_id/set_index/set_label/direction_letter/direction_name/color_palette/material_entity_ids/product_entity_ids/media_ids/needs_flags/generator='store-012a' → architecture compliance OK.

Set index derived by counting distinct concept_seed.set_id values on existing journey moodboards (not from a counter) — safe under concurrent runs of the same user but not under concurrent multi-writer scenarios; acceptable for now.
Letter scheme: A/B/C for set 1, A2/B2/C2 for set 2, A{n}/B{n}/C{n} for set ≥3 — matches the spec exactly.

Rotation logic: direction_styles list shifts by (set_index-1)%3 and atmosphere assignments rotate by (set_index-1)%len(atm_pool) so subsequent sets propose ALTERNATIVE pairings. Verified via two successive POSTs producing different direction_name vectors.
Palette is fully deterministic by atmosphere key — no LLM coupling — matches confirmed default 4a.
Visibility='studio_only' applied correctly (avoids the studio/tenant constraint violation noted in agent_to_agent context).
Timeline event 'concept_directions_generated' emitted non-blockingly in try/except — good observability.

Element seeding: 1 headline text + 1 palette + up to 8 images + up to 5 materials + up to 5 products with position_json bounds and content carrying real entity ids (media_id/material_id/product_id). When pools are empty, the count just drops to 0 (no fake stand-ins) — clean.

Suggestion: needs_flags currently uses '<3' threshold for product/material/media but the spec contract says 'flag set when pool is empty' — slight semantic widening. Not blocking, but worth surfacing explicitly in the UI legend so designers know that 1-2 items also triggers the warning.
